title: How to organize the safety and ppe station | Workshop
description:
Make protective gear so easy to reach that putting it on is faster than skipping it.

This is the Safety and PPE Station in the Workshop. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Safety glasses on hooks at the door you come in through, one labeled pair per regular user, hearing protection beside them, and dust masks in a dated box. An extinguisher mounted on the wall with its gauge in the green and clear floor in front of it, and a first aid kit that still has burn dressings and more than three plasters in it.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Scratched, hazed safety glasses are the reason people stop wearing safety glasses, so bin them.
Straighten: Hang the gear at the door on the path you walk in, not on the far wall past the bench, and sized to the actual
Shine: Wash the lenses in soap and water rather than wiping them on a dusty shop rag, which is what scratches them in
Safety: Lift the extinguisher, check the gauge sits in the green, and confirm nothing has crept into the space in fron
Standardize: Put an inspection date on masking tape on the extinguisher bracket and the first aid kit lid, and hang your sa
Sustain: The gear goes back on the board as you switch off the shop light, never into a drawer or a jacket pocket, so t

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
A full silhouette board at the door, one labeled set per user plus a visitor set, with dated extinguisher and first aid checks.
